findings.detail: Model ID/direction are attached, but source timestamps do not bind every LTF P1/P2/P3 to the specific HTF C1/C2/C3 being illustrated. Main can seek a new TS after C2 confirmation rather than inherit the original C2 sequence. Larger observes its own current chart channel; there is no independent M15 structure engine.
findings.proposal: Track source candle intervals and distinguish original C2 reaction, C3 execution and a genuinely new continuation setup. Select/infer chart roles from actual candle boundaries, not a fixed fractal identity.

findings.detail: Handoff requires earlyState.emitted. The same known TS/MPS evidence transfers when an Early entry was emitted, and is dropped when it was not. FVG/OTE-only observation can lose the chain. Early disabled also disables collection, and an un-emitted window can be blocked at C2 close.

reproduction.scope: Actual handoff statements with constructed state objects; not market Replay

findings.proposal: Separate evidence collection and lifecycle from entry/marker permission; hand off valid same-parent evidence without requiring a trade signal. Keep invalidation/target and closed-time checks.

findings.detail: Auto bias is persistent confirmed pivot-break direction with a chart-close guard and optional prior-key counter-bias exception. It does not classify a move as HTF expansion, pullback to key, countertrend reaction or HTF-aligned continuation. Main/Larger can disagree without a defined contextual precedence.
findings.proposal: Define the HTF hypothesis and key/target relationship separately from LTF trigger direction. Preserve explicit countertrend setups instead of imposing blind higher-frame agreement.

findings.detail: Own CRT target/invalidation are checked. There is no general opposing-HTF-key/remaining-room policy for the first leg or OTE continuation. A reaction at another opposing key does not automatically cause a new continuation hypothesis.
findings.proposal: Distinguish own CRT target completion, arrival at an opposing key, and a new continuation setup. Specify behavior before coding; a key touch must not automatically be equated with guaranteed reversal.

findings.detail: Latest confirmed 2/2 pivots, frozen root, 36-chart-bar wait, one-range expansion reset, directional candle reactions, tracked rather than explicitly segmented first leg and 50–80% OTE acceptance are implementation conventions. Sources do not establish every threshold/branch as an exact universal author algorithm.
findings.proposal: Keep the conventions explicit; validate structure selection and leg segmentation against user-labelled cases without claiming author-exact automation.

findings.detail: Time is feed-boundary context, not a clock-hour entry filter. Swing/FVG/OB/displacement-qualified open-close keys are bounded approximations; named PDL/PDH/WCP/weekly levels are not explicitly catalogued. SMT is an optional adjacent-range comparison, not the complete discretionary concept.
findings.proposal: Document coverage and add only directly sourced, user-relevant time/key rules. Do not invent clock windows or treat all old-method volume/POC conditions as CRT rules.

validation.meaning: Existing implementation contracts pass; this does not prove completeness, market reliability or source fidelity.
validation.reason: No source mutation; prior exact-source compiler validation belongs to the preceding fix.

recommendedOrder: Separate observation/handoff from Early entry permission
Bind LTF evidence to source HTF candle intervals and roles
Specify first-leg targets and opposing-key handling
Add structure-frame support such as M15 and expand labelled-case verification

followup.note: Subsequent implementation covers the five authorized workstreams. Original findings remain the audit-time record; full discretionary source fidelity and market profitability remain unverified.
